Reason: The chest X-ray shows discrete areas of hypotransparency (opacities) in the upper zones of both hemithoraces, but the opacity is visibly larger and more pronounced on the right side. This finding suggests a progression or persistence of pathology consistent with a history of right-sided pneumonia, whereas options claiming symmetry, left-sided predominance, or exclusive right-sided involvement are contradicted by the visual evidence of bilateral but asymmetric disease.
